title: epilobium pubens var. minor
intro: Epilobium pubens var. minor, commonly known as Dwarf Willowherb, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the willowherb family, Onagraceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and menstrual disorders due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Epilobium pubens var. minor include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
